verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents a public REST API with reference pages for charging tokens, introspecting tokens, wallet balance, agent source IPs, and creating org seller agents, all authenticated with per-agent API keys. A runtime probe confirmed the live, key-gated endpoint returns structured errors, and llms.txt is served for agents. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at any probed path, and API key management and service creation are documented only as dashboard steps.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Create your first token in the Playground (or directly via the API with the pre-filled parameters).
Use this API after delivering a service, tool, or resource to collect payment from a buyer-issued token.
Check whether a token is currently usable and get the remaining balance as a buyer or seller agent.
As an Organization Admin, create a seller agent for a user in your organization.
Skyfire's token API is live and key-gated as documented
